items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: And I had attorney Studebaker Lucas.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I had attorney Studebaker Lucas. I didn't know that it was published. But I was doing insurance work then. And one of the officials came to me and told me that he had heard a Don't Let Old Age Creep Upon You on a Music Box at Montague's Restaurant on Claiborne Avenue. So I said, I can't believe it. So he said, come on with me and I'll prove it to you. So we went down there.
Was that under that title or had somebody changed the title?
